title: City of Waterloo cancels snow event and parking ban at 11 a.m. Sunday March 15, 2026
body:
The City of Waterloo is cancelling the current Snow Event and street parking ban as of 11:00 a.m. Sunday March 15, 2026. The team has made significant progress clearing city roads.
For more information about the City’s snow clearing priorities for roads and sidewalks and some tips for driving/parking when plows are active, visit
waterloo.ca/snow
.
Residents are encouraged to subscribe to the City’s
newsfeed
to determine if a parking ban is still in effect.
